chapter.heading: Ephesians 3
The Mystery of the Gospel Revealed
chapter.v: God's grace that was given to me for you,
which was not made known to the sons of men in other generations as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit.
partakers of the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel.
by the working of his power.
according to the eternal purpose that he has realized in Christ Jesus our Lord,
For this reason I bow my knees before the Father,
every family in heaven and on earth is named,
according to the power at work within us,
to him be glory in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

footnotes.footnote: 3:6 The words *This mystery is* are inferred from verse 4
3:15 Or *from whom all fatherhood*; the Greek word *patria* in verse 15 is closely related to the word for *Father* in verse 14
